ask: The Monday posts keep coming out too salesy.
before: Over two weeks the user turned down 3 of the routine's drafts with reasons like 'reads like an ad', each sent with reject-post and categories too_salesy.

steps.why: performance_summary: are drafts being decided, and how many are no's? Here 8 made, 5 decided (2 yes, 3 no), 3 waiting: decided enough to judge the writing.
Bolta's Monday review of this routine: one row, high_rejection, proposing 2 drafts a run instead of 4.
Brand-wide suggestions from approvals and rejections; none for this routine yet.

say: Your last 3 Monday drafts were turned down as too salesy. Bolta recommends 2 drafts a run instead of 4, putting the same effort into fewer. Or I can add one line to its instructions: 'Teach, don't sell: mention an offer only when the post is about it.' Which would you like?
never: Applying a recommendation or editing the routine before the user chooses.

Counting drafts made as if they were drafts decided.
